integrity: Infinite-depth equivalence is supported by constructive winning pebble strategies and explicit defining formula schemata. Finite tuple refinement and independent enumeration are reproducible corroborations, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Nonempty finite one-bijection digraphs over exactly one binary successor relation; no counting quantifiers, function symbols, or additional predicates. Theory classification and minimality are relative to this class. Historical priority may overlap unlocated general results; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Finite-variable theories of permutation digraphs: the 26-class two-variable boundary
